demonstration.narration: I'll open the records behind the ${var.value} requests/second bar to read how long those requests really took.
demonstration.reasoning: A chart bucket shows that latency is high, not where it starts rising. Reading the records on both sides of the change shows where the threshold lies.
demonstration.evidence: This record at ${var.value} requests/second took ${param.load.above_ns_text} ns, or ${param.load.above_s} s (event.duration). Before we filtered, the panel showed much lower latency at ${param.load.below} requests/second. So the saturation point is between the two, around ${truth.finding}.
